failure_dispositions.node-sse-red: Expected regression: 10 failed/2 passed exposed unbounded writes, absent drain ownership, missing queue/frame bounds and terminal cleanup defects. Subsequent focused and complete suites verify fixes.
failure_dispositions.node-sse-green: One retained formatter compatibility assertion failed: shared encoding emitted event before id. Restored the existing id-before-event byte order; focused and final Node suites pass.
failure_dispositions.node-sse-descriptor-red: Expected reviewer regression: statuses 204/205/304 and invalid streamPolicy activated streaming work despite invalid descriptors. Validation moved before headers/source activation; green focused suite has 54 passing tests in four files, plus Content-Length stripping coverage.
failure_dispositions.authority-finalizer-red: One regression exposed a throwing consumer finalizer escaping authority.dispose and preventing another subscriber or queued operation from being released. Isolated interruption/unsubscription faults and continued cleanup; green suite passes all 68 authority tests.
failure_dispositions.platform-live-first: 17 passed/1 failed: the eviction test attempted to evict an authority with an active HTTP stream; the default five-second test timeout expired. Subsequent scoped diagnosis identifies a helper precondition, not orphaned-stream behavior.
failure_dispositions.platform-eviction-trace: Scoped reproduction of active-stream eviction reached the test five-second timeout; superseded by the helper-drain investigation and separated interruption/reconstruction tests.
failure_dispositions.platform-eviction-drain: The helper waited 30 seconds and rejected because the Durable Object still had active references. Final tests use state.abort for active interruption, and cancel then evict then reconnect for reconstruction. Full local process shutdown separately proves actual socket interruption. No lease was added; no stale-delivery finding is claimed.
failure_dispositions.browser-eventsource: Scratch Chromium launched but page creation failed because extracted software-graphics libraries were missing. Extracted bundled SwiftShader from the same npm package; actual browser-eventsource-final passed the complete native EventSource scenario.
failure_dispositions.browser-launch: Scratch bundled Chromium initially failed launch. Binary verification found extraction had not produced the full file; corrected extraction and verified launch are separate subsequent commands. No application dependency or production configuration changed.
failure_dispositions.browser-launch-single: Changing scratch launch flags did not fix the incomplete binary. Verification found 181409595 disk bytes versus 209022176 decompressed bytes. Corrected extraction before launch; browser-launch-verified reports Chromium153.0.8010.0.
